title: The digest with no holiday
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday, the Halloween digest. The cover is the hardware store's pumpkins, unbought, in the rain. The owner says it's the saddest thing in the rack. He says it's not a Halloween cover. She says exactly.

panels.composition: The digest cover: the pallet of pumpkins under the awning, rain, no one. Drawn on the spot.

image.prompt: close on a small photocopied booklet cover showing a pallet of pumpkins under a store awning in rain with no one about, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The LAUNDRY owner with it at the counter. WOOD in the door.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner holding a small booklet at her counter while a young man stands in the doorway, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The rack. The digest beside a church bulletin with a pumpkin on it.

image.prompt: close on a wire rack holding a photocopied booklet beside a church bulletin printed with a pumpkin, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The laundromat window from the street: two skeletons, the rack, the owner. Rain. Wood gone.

image.prompt: a laundromat window at dusk with two paper skeletons and a flyer rack visible through the glass, rain outside, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'Exactly.' The saddest thing in the rack is the cover.
